title: The region around MWC 147
caption: The region around the young star MWC 147 in Monoceros, imaged from ESO's Paranal Observatory with a 200 mm lens
celestial: MWC 147, NGC 2247 · about 2500 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESO press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: The rich, colorful region around the Cone Nebula sits at center left of this wide-field image, with the Rosette Nebula at top right. Both lie in the constellation Monoceros, very close to the better-known Orion. The view takes in the star-forming complex NGC 2247 and the young star MWC 147.

MWC 147 sits near a dark nebula in the upper left part of the frame. It is classed as a Herbig Ae/Be object, a young star still in its formative stages, and it belongs to Monoceros OB1, an association of massive stars. A dark nebula is a dense cloud of dust that blocks light from behind it.

This picture was not taken with a large observatory telescope. Stéphane Guisard of ESO photographed it from Paranal with a 200 mm lens, combining exposures through R, V, B and hydrogen-alpha filters for a total of more than 16 hours. That long total exposure is what brings out the faint glow of the nebulae.
scale: The source lists a distance of 2500 light years, so the light in this picture set out roughly 2,500 years ago.

understand.summary: This is a visible-light color composite made with a 200 mm camera lens, using R, V, B and hydrogen-alpha filters. The color assigned to each filter isn't published.
understand.eye: More than 16 hours of total exposure gather far more light than the eye can, revealing nebulae far too faint to see like this unaided.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

explore: MWC 147 lies about 2500 light-years away. Grouping massive stars into associations such as Monoceros OB1 helps astronomers trace which stars formed together from the same clouds of gas and dust.
alt: A wide field of sky with a colorful nebula region at center left, another nebula at top right and a dark nebula at top left.
